# Khalij Fars Rail (Fars Rail)

> International rail freight, transit corridors, and multimodal logistics solutions connecting Iran, CIS countries, Turkey, Afghanistan, and the Middle East.

## Overview
- **Company Name:** Khalij Fars Rail International Transportation (Fars Rail)
- **Primary Website:** https://farsrail.com
- **Industry:** Rail Freight Logistics, International Transit, Multimodal Transportation
- **Experience:** Over 25 years of industry experience
- **Network Scope:** 10+ countries connected, 5,000+ wagons managed, 300+ satisfied corporate clients

## Core Services
- **Rail Transportation:** Full-cycle wagon services across CIS nations, Iran, and regional corridors.
- **Road Transportation:** Flexible door-to-door road delivery and first/last-mile logistics connectivity.
- **Transit Services:** Multimodal regional transit corridors linking maritime ports to landlocked Eurasian markets.
- **Wagon Supply & Reservation:** Reliable procurement and reservation of covered boxcars, open-top wagons, tank wagons, and container flatbeds.
- **Customs Clearance & Documentation:** Fast compliance, transshipment documentation, transit permits, and insurance at critical border terminals.
- **Warehousing & Supply Chain:** Secure cargo consolidation and depot management.

## Network & Terminals
### Key Terminals in Iran
- **Mashhad & Motahari:** Main operational headquarters and logistics hubs.
- **Sarakhs & Inche Borun & Lotf Abad:** Primary border gateways to Turkmenistan and Central Asia.
- **Bandar Abbas:** Deep-sea maritime gateway connecting the Persian Gulf to overland rail corridors.
- **Tehran, Yazd, Isfahan:** Central industrial and manufacturing transport hubs.

### Target Destinations & Corridors
- **CIS & Central Asia:** Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Russia.
- **Regional Partners:** Turkey, Afghanistan, Middle East.
